label: Federal deals tracked against real prices. Not a signal, not a backtest, not advice.
method: Every return is measured from the close of the announcement session — the first price a retail account could actually pay — not from the government's own basis, which is usually far lower and is not available to you. Each name is compared with SPY over the identical window, so the column that matters is excess return, not the headline gain. Deals where the government takes revenue rather than investing (Nvidia, AMD) are shown but excluded from the scorecard.
disclaimer: Policy events are not a validated edge. The move is concentrated in the first session and frequently pre-market, which means the headline is usually unbuyable, and several of these names have round-tripped the entire announcement move. Treat this as a research desk for reading policy risk, not as a buy list.

positions.name: The Elmet Group
positions.structure: $450M committed: redeemable preferred plus warrants for up to 19.9%, funding tungsten and molybdenum capacity. Newest deal on the board.

positions.name: Alcoa
positions.structure: ~$174M of equity in the project vehicle for the Wagerup gallium refinery, plus offtake. Stake is in the project, not the parent.

positions.name: Rigetti Computing
positions.structure: Up to $100M for a minority non-controlling stake. Announced 21 May 2026, definitive 8 Sep 2026 — the confirmation moved the stock a quarter as much as the announcement did.

positions.name: D-Wave Quantum
positions.structure: $100M CHIPS award for a minority stake (~1.9%). Part of a nine-company, ~$2B quantum tranche.

positions.name: IBM
positions.structure: $1B toward a 300mm quantum wafer foundry venture for a minority non-controlling stake. Reported at LOI stage.

positions.name: GlobalFoundries
positions.structure: Two CHIPS awards totalling ~$675M (quantum foundry plus silicon photonics) for roughly 1.8% combined.

positions.name: USA Rare Earth
positions.structure: Letter of intent for access to up to $1.6B, with an equity stake plus warrants. LOI, not a definitive agreement — terms can still move.

positions.name: L3Harris
positions.structure: $1B convertible preferred in the Missile Solutions unit, auto-converting at its spin-off IPO. First Pentagon equity position in a major prime. Conversion is subject to appropriations.

positions.name: Cameco
positions.structure: Public read-through to the $80B Westinghouse AP1000 partnership. The government's warrants are in Westinghouse (private), not in Cameco — you own the partner, not the stake.

positions.name: Trilogy Metals
positions.structure: $35.6M for 10% of common plus 7.5% in penny warrants, tied to the Ambler Road access decision in Alaska.

positions.name: Lithium Americas
positions.structure: Penny warrants for 5% of the company plus 5% of the Thacker Pass JV, tied to restructuring the $2.23B DOE loan. No cash outlay by the government.

positions.name: Intel
positions.structure: 9.9% of common (433M sh) at $20.47, converting $8.9B of unpaid CHIPS and Secure Enclave money. Extra 5% warrant only if Intel sells majority control of Foundry. No board seat, no exit plan.

positions.name: Nvidia
positions.structure: 15% of China H20 revenue paid to the government for export licences, later 25% on H200. The government is taking value out, not putting it in. Both names fell on the news.

positions.name: AMD
positions.structure: 15% of China MI308 revenue to the government in exchange for export licences. Same structure as Nvidia: a levy dressed as a partnership.

positions.name: MP Materials
positions.structure: $400M convertible preferred at $30.03 plus warrants, ~15% as-converted. The real asset is contractual: a 10-year $110/kg NdPr price floor and 100% magnet offtake from the 10X facility.

Antimony and gold at Stibnite; antimony is on every stockpile list and has no US production.

Maritime Action Plan and the Navy shipbuilding overhaul. Note the buyback restrictions cut the other way.
Rare earth and critical minerals build-out attached to an existing coal cash flow.
Uranium plus a rare-earth separation line already running — the exact profile the DoW has been funding.
Named in DOE fast-track lists; pre-revenue, so entirely a policy-narrative position.
Largest listed pure-play in small UAS as procurement dollars concentrate.
Domestic HALEU enrichment — the bottleneck in every advanced-reactor timeline.
Drone tariffs and the Pentagon fly-off programmes point straight at it.
Niobium, scandium, titanium at Elk Creek; has an EXIM and DoD funding history.
